title: XII. Governance by fulfillment: permitting, impeding, effecting, tolerating; Cap. 35 close
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): But in truth, by means belonging toward ye fall belonging toward ye first parents ye salutary modes belonging toward teaching were weakened, plus ye modes belonging toward fulfillment impeded, as will appear out from ye following chapter 37. You will see these modes belonging toward fulfillment in 2 Peter 2:4 plus following. or effects it while benefiting or afflicting them, or tolerates it in them — by way belonging toward fulfillment God governs human beings when He permits or impedes something spiritual or bodily. XII.
pass_b_english: XII. By way of fulfillment God governs human beings when He permits or impedes something spiritual or bodily, or effects it while benefiting or afflicting them, or tolerates it in them. You will see these modes of fulfillment in 2 Peter 2:4 and following. But in truth, by the fall of the first parents the salutary modes of teaching were weakened, and the modes of fulfillment impeded, as will appear from the following chapter 37.
source_text: XII. Per modum impletionis Deus gubernat homines, cum aliquid spirituale vel corporale permittit aut impedit, aut efficit eis benefaciens vel eos affligens, aut in eis tolerat. Hos modos implendi videbis 2 Petr. 2:4 et seqq. Verum enimvero lapsione primorum parentum salutares modi docendi sunt enervati, et modi implendi impediti, ut ex sequenti cap. 37 patebit.
